column1: # The disks of the activities, fetched into disks/ by fetch-disks.sh.
# One disk a line, the fields separated by tabs:
#   name     the file in disks/, the name the guides and the generators use
#   sha256   of that file, "-" while it is not known yet
#   source   the URL to download, or "blank:<bytes>" for an empty disk
#   member   optional, the file to take out of a zip download
